papers.title: User Embeddings are Superpositions of Interpretable Behavioral Modes
papers.translated_title: 用户嵌入是可解释行为模式的叠加
papers.author: Jonathan Kozaczuk
papers.summary: User embeddings are central components of modern recommendation, personalization, and behavioral modeling systems. Though these embeddings can compactly encode rich behavioral information, they are inherently dense and opaque, limiting interpretability. To address this gap, we argue that user embeddings can be understood as sparse superpositions of interpretable behavioral modes. This structure is directly predicted by generative models of user behavior for linear embeddings and extends approximately to deep-learning representations by the superposition hypothesis. Superimposed modes can naturally be recovered by sparse dictionary learning methods, such as sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and recovered modes can be automatically named and queried in natural language. We validate mode recovery against known ground truth on synthetic data, where SAEs recover modes better than classical sparse baselines, including on transformer-encoded embeddings. We then apply the method to classical and transformer-based user embeddings from two real-world datasets. We also show how the corresponding natural-language labels enable zero-shot audience retrieval and characterization over embeddings never trained on text. The framework is post-hoc and model-agnostic, requiring no modification to the upstream embedding system.
papers.translated_summary: 用户嵌入是现代推荐、个性化和行为建模系统的核心组件。尽管这些嵌入能够紧凑地编码丰富的行为信息，但它们本质上是稠密且不透明的，限制了可解释性。为弥补这一不足，我们认为用户嵌入可以被理解为可解释行为模式的稀疏叠加。这一结构在线性嵌入下可由用户行为的生成模型直接预测，并通过叠加假设近似推广到深度学习表示。叠加的模式可以通过稀疏字典学习方法自然恢复，例如稀疏自编码器（SAEs），且恢复的模式可以自动命名并用自然语言进行查询。我们在合成数据上以已知的真实基准验证了模式恢复效果，其中SAEs在恢复模式方面优于经典稀疏基线，包括在Transformer编码的嵌入上。随后我们将该方法应用于来自两个真实世界数据集的经典用户嵌入和基于Transformer的用户嵌入。我们还展示了相应的自然语言标签如何支持对从未在文本上训练过的嵌入进行零样本受众检索和刻画。该框架是事后且模型无关的，无需修改上游嵌入系统。

papers.title: Do You Miss the Nights We Spent Crafting Figures? Rethinking Teaser and Framework Figures in the Age of Generative AI
papers.translated_title: 你是否怀念我们制作图形的那些夜晚？生成式人工智能时代对预告图与框架图的再思考
papers.author: Xiaoqi Zhao
papers.summary: Scientific figures give research ideas a visual form through choices of abstraction, composition, and emphasis. Generative AI offers new ways to realize these choices, raising questions about explanatory clarity and purposeful visual expression. We examine these questions through a visual retrospective of 371 motivation and framework figures from 200 papers. The corpus comprises a quota-based main sample of 160 papers spanning four temporal periods and a separate purposive style-contrast sample of 40 papers. A single multimodal judge evaluates six dimensions of communication and design, with three repeated judgments per figure. We attempt source-constrained revisions of all 371 figures, of which 369 pass the recorded fidelity checks. Original-figure ratings show no uniform decline across periods. Revisions increase mean clarity ratings by 0.428 points and decrease aesthetic coherence ratings by 0.111 points on a five-point scale. Gains in the six-dimension average are larger for main-sample motivation figures than for frameworks. Case analyses show that added explanation can clarify comparisons while leaving typographic hierarchy and visual economy unresolved. These model-based findings support researcher-led design, with AI assisting exploration and authors retaining responsibility for explanatory purpose, composition, and scientific relationships. The accompanying atlas and evaluation records are available at https://ntu-ai4x.github.io/Rethinking_Figures/index_en.html.
papers.translated_summary: 科学图表通过抽象、构图和强调的选择，将研究思想赋予视觉形式。生成式AI为实现这些选择提供了新途径，同时也引发了关于解释清晰度和有目的的视觉表达的问题。我们通过对来自200篇论文的371幅动机图和框架图进行视觉回顾来考察这些问题。该语料库包括一个基于配额的主样本，涵盖四个时间段共160篇论文，以及一个独立的立意性风格对比样本，共40篇论文。由单一多模态评判者对传播与设计的六个维度进行评估，每幅图重复评判三次。我们尝试对所有371幅图进行源约束修订，其中369幅通过了记录的保真度检查。原始图表的评分在各时间段之间未显示出一致性下降。修订使清晰度平均评分提高了0.428分，使美学连贯性平均评分降低了0.111分（五分制）。六个维度平均分的提升在主样本的动机图中大于框架图。案例分析表明，增加解释可以阐明比较关系，但排版层级和视觉经济性仍未得到解决。这些基于模型的发现支持研究者主导的设计，AI辅助探索，作者保留对解释目的、构图和科学关系的责任。随附的图谱和评估记录可在 https://ntu-ai4x.github.io/Rethinking_Figures/index_en.html 获取。

papers.title: Where and Why is Grounded Reasoning Useful?
papers.translated_title: 基于推理的推理在何处以及为何有用？
papers.author: David Yan
papers.summary: Grounded reasoning, where a model outputs text coordinates of relevant locations in chain-of-thought reasoning, is a common strategy for solving complex visual reasoning problems. However, the benefits and limitations of grounded reasoning are understudied. We study where and why grounded reasoning is most useful. To do so, we introduce a chain-of-thought analysis method to measure how much a model uses its outputted grounding in its thinking trace and perform a detailed ablation study of a grounded reasoning training recipe. We find that grounded reasoning improves counting but shows no significant gain over baselines without coordinate grounding across a wide range of spatial reasoning and perception benchmarks. Using several synthetic tasks, we show that grounded reasoning is most useful when a task requires undescribable references, which are visual concepts that are difficult to describe in language. However, we observe that many existing visual reasoning benchmarks are solvable with only describable text references. To close this gap, we introduce BrickVision, a new benchmark that requires undescribable visual references to solve.
papers.translated_summary: 基于落地的推理，即模型在思维链推理中输出相关位置的文本坐标，是解决复杂视觉推理问题的一种常见策略。然而，落地推理的优势与局限性尚未得到充分研究。我们研究落地推理在何处以及为何最为有用。为此，我们引入一种思维链分析方法，以衡量模型在其思维轨迹中对其输出的落地信息的使用程度，并对一种落地推理训练方案进行详细的消融研究。我们发现，落地推理改善了计数能力，但在广泛的空间推理与感知基准上，相较于无坐标落地的基线并未表现出显著提升。通过若干合成任务，我们表明落地推理在任务需要不可描述指代时最为有用，不可描述指代是难以用语言描述的视觉概念。然而，我们观察到许多现有的视觉推理基准仅凭可描述的文本指代即可解决。为弥补这一差距，我们引入 BrickVision，一个需要不可描述视觉指代才能解决的新基准。

papers.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
papers.translated_title: SwarmEvolve：用于进化发现与优化的潜在智能体集群
papers.author: Qile Jiang
papers.summary: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. We present SwarmEvolve, a framework in which hundreds of low-cost agents per round work in swarms, reason in latent space without decoding to text, and share information by passing KV caches. Each swarm studies the problem from a different angle. A novelty filter keeps the most distinct agent ideas by directly measuring the distances between the agents' hidden state vectors. Crossover of ideas happens naturally in latent space, as a summarizer agent receives the combined KV caches of all swarm members. On 21 problems in mathematical discovery and scientific computing, SwarmEvolve gets the highest average score and needs a median of only 3 to 8 minutes to reach the best scores that other state-of-the-art frameworks reach in 60 minutes. On several problems, SwarmEvolve with Qwen3 8B improves on the solutions that AlphaEvolve first found with frontier LLMs. Our work shows that agent swarms that communicate in latent space offer a fast, low-cost approach to program search for scientific problems.
papers.translated_summary: LLM引导的进化搜索利用AI智能体，通过迭代优化解并组合高分方法来改进数学与计算问题的程序。然而，这一过程往往较慢，因为LLM在每一轮都会生成冗长的文本思维链，并且必须多次重复这一生成过程以维持种群多样性。我们提出SwarmEvolve，这是一个框架，其中每轮有数百个低成本智能体以群体方式协同工作，在潜在空间中进行推理而无需解码为文本，并通过传递KV缓存来共享信息。每个群体从不同角度研究问题。新颖性过滤器通过直接测量智能体隐藏状态向量之间的距离，保留最具差异性的智能体想法。思想的交叉在潜在空间中自然发生，因为一个总结器智能体接收所有群体成员的组合KV缓存。在数学发现和科学计算中的21个问题上，SwarmEvolve获得了最高的平均得分，并且仅需中位数3到8分钟即可达到其他最先进框架在60分钟内达到的最佳得分。在若干问题上，使用Qwen3 8B的SwarmEvolve改进了AlphaEvolve最初使用前沿LLM找到的解。我们的工作表明，在潜在空间中通信的智能体群体为科学问题的程序搜索提供了一种快速、低成本的方法。

papers.title: Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists
papers.translated_title: 科学家世界：为AI科学家培育一个研究世界
papers.author: Taiming Lu
papers.summary: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. Our autonomous pipeline extracts each paper's open-ended research question and reproduces its proposed method as the baseline; an AI-Scientist entering the environment is evaluated against what the human authors achieved. We release the first 1,000 verified environments. With the world as an evaluation, we found that frontier AI-Scientists can already surpass the human researchers 74% of the time. As a record of how AI does science, it contains 6,400 hours of research traces, with every idea, experiment, failure, and success. As a training ground, we are able to raise (+158%) a small model to match frontier models in research ideation. At last, AI-Scientists' own world has arrived, grown from and growing with science itself.
papers.translated_summary: AI-Scientists已经到来，但一个供它们成长的世界尚未建立。人类科学家对此习以为常——数百年的开放问题与共享思想，静候于科学文献之中。对AI-Scientists而言，那个世界可读却不可运行，因此我们为它们构建了Scientist World：每一篇研究论文都成为一个可执行环境。我们的自主流水线提取每篇论文的开放式研究问题，并将其提出的方法复现为基线；进入环境的AI-Scientist将对照人类作者所取得的成果接受评估。我们发布了首批1,000个经过验证的环境。以这个世界作为评估基准，我们发现前沿AI-Scientists已经能够在74%的情况下超越人类研究者。作为AI如何从事科学研究的记录，它包含6,400小时的研究轨迹，涵盖每一个想法、实验、失败与成功。作为训练场，我们能够将一个小型模型提升（+158%），使其在研究构思方面媲美前沿模型。最终，AI-Scientists自己的世界已经到来，它从科学本身中生长出来，并与科学共同成长。

papers.title: EgoGeneralist: Unifying Egocentric Action-Video Tasks through Video-Native Modeling
papers.translated_title: EgoGeneralist：通过视频原生建模统一自我中心动作视频任务
papers.author: Yanlin Jin
papers.summary: Modern video models possess strong visual priors, yet do not natively represent human action in metric 3D space. We present EgoGeneralist, which adapts pretrained video generators to unify action-conditioned egocentric video generation, pose estimation, and joint action-video generation. Our role-adaptive action renderer provides video-native representations for multidirectional action-video learning, making metric motion usable as both a spatial control signal and a recoverable generation target. Cross-stream action-video coupling establishes close correspondence between metric motion and visual dynamics through lightweight adaptation while preserving the pretrained visual prior. Together, these designs establish a generalist framework spanning five action-video tasks. Despite adaptation only on controlled laboratory recordings, EgoGeneralist generalizes to diverse unseen scenes and interactions with effective action control and visual quality, bridging pretrained visual knowledge and metric 3D human motion.
papers.translated_summary: 现代视频模型具备强大的视觉先验，但并不能原生地在度量三维空间中表示人类动作。我们提出EgoGeneralist，将预训练视频生成器改造为统一动作条件的第一人称视角视频生成、姿态估计与联合动作-视频生成。我们的角色自适应动作渲染器为多方向动作-视频学习提供视频原生表示，使度量运动既可作为空间控制信号，又可作为可恢复的生成目标。跨流动作-视频耦合通过轻量适配在度量运动与视觉动态之间建立紧密对应，同时保留预训练视觉先验。这些设计共同构建了一个涵盖五项动作-视频任务的通用框架。尽管仅在受控实验室录制数据上进行适配，EgoGeneralist仍能泛化到多样化的未见场景与交互，并具备有效的动作控制与视觉质量，弥合了预训练视觉知识与度量三维人体运动之间的差距。

papers.title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
papers.translated_title: XStack：机器学习仓库迁移基准
papers.author: Linrong Cai
papers.summary: ML code should run where researchers choose, not where it was first written. Today, machine learning code mainly lives in two ecosystems, PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs and JAX on Google TPUs. Migrating repositories between them means building and testing across frameworks and hardware. This migration is (1) a practical need, since it unlocks different hardware for researchers, and (2) a natural benchmark: it involves different frameworks and hardware, covers whole repositories, and is long-horizon and challenging. We introduce XStack, a benchmark that evaluates agents on migrating ML repositories between these two ecosystems. Each agent receives a PyTorch repository and a clean TPU machine and must deliver a JAX repository. Its output passes if it meets our grading criteria, based on the source repository's published result, authenticated and calibrated by us. Migration by agents remains unreliable: Claude Opus 5 passes 75%, GPT-5.6-sol 45%, and every other agent at most 40%. XStack is a step toward freeing ML code from its ecosystem. We release XStack to make progress toward reliable migration across frameworks and hardware measurable.
papers.translated_summary: 机器学习代码应当在研究者选择的环境中运行，而不是在它最初被编写的地方运行。如今，机器学习代码主要存在于两个生态系统中：NVIDIA GPU 上的 PyTorch 和 Google TPU 上的 JAX。在这些生态系统之间迁移代码仓库，意味着要跨框架和硬件进行构建与测试。这种迁移（1）是一种实际需求，因为它为研究者解锁了不同的硬件；（2）是一个天然的基准：它涉及不同的框架和硬件，覆盖整个代码仓库，并且是长周期且具有挑战性的。我们推出 XStack，一个评估智能体在这两个生态系统之间迁移机器学习代码仓库的基准。每个智能体收到一个 PyTorch 代码仓库和一台干净的 TPU 机器，并且必须交付一个 JAX 代码仓库。如果其输出满足我们的评分标准，则通过，该标准基于源仓库已发表的结果，并由我们进行认证和校准。智能体进行的迁移仍然不可靠：Claude Opus 5 通过率为 75%，GPT-5.6-sol 为 45%，其他所有智能体至多为 40%。XStack 是朝着将机器学习代码从其生态系统中解放出来迈出的一步。我们发布 XStack，以使跨框架和硬件的可靠迁移取得进展并可被度量。

papers.title: Same Behavior, Different Mechanism: What Finite Experiments Can Certify About Integrated Information
papers.translated_title: 相同行为，不同机制：有限实验能就整合信息证明什么
papers.author: Linqian Wu
papers.summary: Interpretability, AI auditing and assessments of machine consciousness increasingly rest on mechanism-level quantities: functionals of a system's causal transition law that describe how it computes, not what it outputs. Experiments see that law only through finite, partial and noisy interventions. We ask when such a quantity is identifiable from an experiment's access, continuous in the mechanism and certifiable from finite data, and answer exactly for a deliberately demanding case - the integrated information $\varphi$ of integrated information theory - in stochastic networks of four and five units with known ground truth. Behavior can be silent: a recurrent and a feed-forward network with identical input-output laws at their response delay carry 0.28 and 0 bits, yet internal recordings separate them within 4-53 trials. Partial access can be just as blind: in our examples, units left out of a one-step recording impose precision floors of 0.30-1.02 bits that no sample size lowers, and in all-but-self parity networks, recordings of any length see several hidden units only through the product of their fidelities - a symmetry that one intervention broke in exact checks. The measure has sharp edges: because $\varphi$ selects a partition, and the cause and effect it specifies, by one criterion and reports another, infinitesimal changes of mechanism that cross an edge change it by 25-100% at 99% of the edges we found in random networks, and about 1% of surrogate models that fit interventional data almost perfectly misreport it by more than 20%. One-sided claims survive: the same data certify a lower bound on both sides of an edge, and we prove $\varphi>1.004$ bits throughout a 64-dimensional region of mechanisms and certify it from about $10^7$ controlled transitions with false-certificate probability at most $α$. Measurability is thus a design question with computable answers.
papers.translated_summary: 可解释性、AI审计和机器意识评估日益依赖于机制层面的量：系统因果转移律的泛函，这些泛函描述系统如何计算，而非输出什么。实验只能通过有限、部分且含噪的干预来观察该定律。我们追问：这样的量在何种条件下可从实验的访问中辨识、在机制上连续、并能从有限数据中得到认证，并针对一个刻意严苛的案例——整合信息论中的整合信息$\varphi$——在具有已知真值的四单元和五单元随机网络中给出精确回答。行为可以是沉默的：一个循环网络和一个前馈网络在其响应延迟处具有相同的输入-输出律，却分别携带0.28比特和0比特，而内部记录可在4-53次试验内将二者区分。部分访问同样可能盲目：在我们的例子中，被排除在单步记录之外的单元施加了0.30-1.02比特的精度下限，任何样本量都无法降低；而在全但自身奇偶网络中，任意长度的记录只能通过其保真度的乘积来观察若干隐藏单元——这一对称性在精确检验中被一次干预打破。该度量具有尖锐边缘：由于$\varphi$依据一个准则选择划分及其指定的原因与结果，却报告另一个准则，机制在跨越边缘时的无穷小变化会使其改变25-100%，这发生在我们于随机网络中发现的99%的边缘处；而约1%的替代模型虽几乎完美拟合干预数据，却对其误报超过20%。单侧断言仍然成立：同一数据可认证边缘两侧的下界，我们证明$\varphi>1.004$比特在一个64维机制区域内处处成立，并从约$10^7$次受控转移中加以认证，错误认证概率至多为$\alpha$。因此，可测量性是一个具有可计算答案的设计问题。

papers.title: Towards interpreting any residual stream direction by scaling activation inversion
papers.translated_title: 走向通过缩放激活反演来解释任何残差流方向
papers.author: Celeste De Schamphelaere
papers.summary: To interpret a direction in a language model's residual stream, we can look for text that strongly activates it. But when such text is found by scanning a corpus, it is limited to what that corpus contains. We develop Maximally-Activating Example Metamodels (MAEMs), language models which map residual stream directions from a subject model to text exemplars that strongly activate those directions. Our objective is to maximise the cosine similarity of a supplied residual stream direction with the activations of the text generated by the MAEM. This label-free RL objective helps to scale MAEMs on diverse sources of residual stream directions. Empirically, we find the resultant metamodel produces informative exemplars: a Qwen3.6-27B MAEM inverts held-out activations better than corpus search or a natural-language autoencoder (NLA), beats corpus search (at 10M tokens) on a majority of held-out languages/domains, and activates 89% of held-out SAE features. It also identifies concepts behind steering vectors about as well as NLAs, recovers the payloads of LoRA backdoors more often than corpus search, and can even verbalise some model workspace inner monologue. Unlike explanations produced by other metamodels (e.g. NLAs), MAEM exemplars can be verified with a forward pass on the subject model, making the MAEM objective a grounded alternative for scaling the training of metamodels.
papers.translated_summary: 要解释语言模型残差流中的某个方向，我们可以寻找能强烈激活该方向的文本。但通过扫描语料库找到的此类文本受限于该语料库所包含的内容。我们开发了最大激活示例元模型（MAEMs），这是一种语言模型，可将主体模型的残差流方向映射到能强烈激活这些方向的文本示例。我们的目标是最大化所给残差流方向与 MAEM 生成文本的激活之间的余弦相似度。这种无标签的强化学习目标有助于在不同来源的残差流方向上扩展 MAEM。在实证中，我们发现所得的元模型能产生有信息量的示例：一个 Qwen3.6-27B MAEM 在反转留出激活方面优于语料库搜索或自然语言自编码器（NLA），在大多数留出语言/领域上优于语料库搜索（1000 万 token），并能激活 89% 的留出 SAE 特征。它识别引导向量背后概念的能力与 NLA 大致相当，比语料库搜索更频繁地恢复 LoRA 后门的载荷，甚至能将某些模型工作区的内部独白言语化。与其他元模型（如 NLA）产生的解释不同，MAEM 示例可以通过对主体模型进行一次前向传播来验证，使 MAEM 目标成为扩展元模型训练的可靠替代方案。

papers.title: Adversarial Training with Large Step Sizes: Implicit Bias, Optimization, and Sharpness
papers.translated_title: 大步骤对抗训练：隐式偏差、优化与锐度
papers.author: Yi Feng
papers.summary: Adversarial Training (AT) is an important method for improving model robustness. We study the dynamics of deterministic Gradient Descent (GD) in AT. Most existing works in this direction focus on the small or vanishing step sizes regime, where GD resembles a continuous-time flow. However, such step sizes can make training inefficient and are rarely used in practice. In this paper, we study the AT dynamics of GD with large constant step sizes. We first study GD in adversarial linear logistic regression, focusing on two aspects: where the model parameters converge (implicit bias) and how quickly the losses decrease (optimization). We then turn to neural networks training and study how the sharpness of losses evolve during AT. Our results advance the understanding of the behaviors of GD with large step sizes in AT and highlight three key differences from its behavior in Standard Training (ST): (i) the implicit bias gap between AT and ST, previously established only for small step sizes, persists for arbitrarily large constant step sizes, (ii) different from ST, there is no uniform rate of convergence for the optimization error in AT, and (iii) sharpness can exhibit two-stage dynamics that differ from the Edge-of-Stability behavior observed in ST.
papers.translated_summary: 对抗训练（Adversarial Training, AT）是提升模型鲁棒性的重要方法。我们研究了对抗训练中确定性梯度下降（Gradient Descent, GD）的动力学。该方向上现有的大多数工作关注小步长或消失步长情形，此时梯度下降类似于连续时间流。然而，这样的步长会使训练效率低下，在实践中很少使用。本文研究大步长常数步长下梯度下降的对抗训练动力学。我们首先研究对抗线性逻辑回归中的梯度下降，重点关注两个方面：模型参数收敛到哪里（隐式偏差）以及损失下降有多快（优化）。随后我们转向神经网络训练，研究对抗训练过程中损失的锐度如何演化。我们的结果推进了对对抗训练中大步长梯度下降行为的理解，并突出了其与标准训练（Standard Training, ST）行为之间的三个关键差异：（i）对抗训练与标准训练之间的隐式偏差差距此前仅在小步长下建立，该差距在任意大的常数步长下依然存在；（ii）与标准训练不同，对抗训练中优化误差不存在一致的收敛速率；（iii）锐度可能呈现两阶段动力学，不同于标准训练中观察到的稳定性边缘行为。

papers.title: Temporal Progression of Prior Precision, Surprisal, Model Updating and Tone Adaptation in Human Auditory Cortices
papers.translated_title: 人类听觉皮层中先验精度、惊奇度、模型更新与音调适应的时间进程
papers.author: van Haren, J. J. G.
papers.summary: Auditory perception emerges from the continuous integration of incoming acoustic signals with statistical predictions, a process complemented by simpler local adaptation. Yet, how all these concurrent mechanisms unfold in time remains underexplored. Using magnetoencephalography (MEG) in participants listening to stochastic tone sequences with periodically shifting inferential statistics, we modelled the temporal, spatial, and spectral dynamics of stimulus-specific repetition suppression, surprisal, model updating, and prior precision. By concurrently tracking these computational parameters within this dynamic auditory environment, we revealed a distinct chronological hierarchy governing predictive and adaptive processing. Prior precision states - reflecting expectations - emerged earliest, followed by rapid and concurrent repetition suppression and surprisal - reflecting local acoustic attenuation and global mismatch detection. These initial dynamics culminated in subsequent, distributed model updates within fronto-parietal networks. Spectrally, these components mapped onto diverging oscillatory fingerprints, ranging from theta-alpha modulation during adaptation to beta suppression during surprisal and broad spectral dampening during precision weighting. Together, these findings demonstrate that the brain navigates uncertain auditory environments through a cascade of neural processes, where fast, local sensory gating and mismatch signals precede the hierarchical revision of internal models.
papers.translated_summary: 听觉感知产生于输入声学信号与统计预测的持续整合过程，这一过程由更简单的局部适应加以补充。然而，这些并行机制如何在时间中展开仍研究不足。我们利用脑磁图（MEG）记录参与者聆听具有周期性变化的推断统计特性的随机音调序列，对刺激特异性重复抑制、惊奇度、模型更新和先验精度的时空与频谱动态进行了建模。通过在这一动态听觉环境中同时追踪这些计算参数，我们揭示了支配预测性与适应性加工的一个独特的时间层级结构。反映期望的先验精度状态最早出现，随后是快速且并发的重复抑制与惊奇度——分别反映局部声学衰减和全局失配检测。这些初始动态最终汇聚为额顶网络中随后的分布式模型更新。在频谱上，这些成分映射到不同的振荡特征，从适应过程中的θ-α调制，到惊奇度期间的β抑制，以及精度加权期间的广泛频谱衰减。总之，这些发现表明，大脑通过一系列神经过程在不确定的听觉环境中导航，其中快速的局部感觉门控和失配信号先于内部模型的层级化修正。

papers.title: Ranging and territoriality in African Apes
papers.translated_title: 非洲猿类的活动范围与领域性
papers.author: Surbeck, M.
papers.summary: Intergroup relations vary strikingly among African apes, with only chimpanzees showing intense, often lethal territoriality. The economic defendability hypothesis proposes that such territorial behaviour is favored where home ranges can be economically defended, as indexed by the ratio of daily travel distance to home range diameter. To test this idea, we compiled and analyzed comparable data on yearly home range size, daily travel distance and defendability indices from one population of each nonhuman African ape species and integrated these with comparable published data. We find that bonobos had substantially larger home ranges and longer daily travel distances than chimpanzees and gorillas, contradicting a prevailing assumption that bonobos experience higher or more reliable food abundance. Defendability indices were higher in chimpanzees and bonobos than in mountain gorillas, but did not differ significantly between chimpanzees, bonobos, and western gorillas. Overall, our results indicate that economic defendability alone cannot explain interspecific variation in territoriality and that our current understanding of ecological differences between the species of the genus Pan have to be revised. Possible additional factors shaping space use of neighboring groups include mate competition within groups.
papers.translated_summary: 非洲猿类之间的群体间关系差异显著，只有黑猩猩表现出强烈的、往往致命的领域性。经济可防卫性假说提出，这种行为在家园范围可以被经济地防卫时受到青睐，其指标为每日移动距离与家园范围直径之比。为检验这一观点，我们汇编并分析了每种非人类非洲猿类各一个种群的年度家园范围大小、每日移动距离和可防卫性指数的可比数据，并将这些数据与已发表的可比数据整合。我们发现，倭黑猩猩的家园范围显著大于黑猩猩和大猩猩，每日移动距离也更长，这与倭黑猩猩食物丰度更高或更稳定的主流假设相矛盾。黑猩猩和倭黑猩猩的可防卫性指数高于山地大猩猩，但黑猩猩、倭黑猩猩和西部大猩猩之间无显著差异。总体而言，我们的结果表明，仅凭经济可防卫性无法解释领域性的种间变异，且我们目前对Pan属各种之间生态差异的理解必须修正。塑造邻近群体空间利用的可能额外因素包括群体内的配偶竞争。

papers.title: Structural Basis for Human Milk Oligosaccharides Recognition by Evolutionarily Dominant Norovirus Genogroup II Genotypes
papers.translated_title: 人乳寡糖被进化优势诺如病毒基因群II基因型识别的结构基础
papers.author: Pisapia, L.
papers.summary: Human noroviruses are a major cause of acute gastroenteritis. Human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) contain glycan motifs similar to histo-blood group antigens and may act as soluble decoys that reduce viral attachment. However, the molecular basis of HMO recognition by the P domain of the major capsid protein VP1 of different norovirus genotypes is not fully understood. Here, we combined ligand-based and protein-based NMR experiments with X-ray crystallography to study HMO binding to the P domain of the latent GII.2, dominant GII.4 and emerging GII.17 noroviruses genotypes. Screening of 12 HMOs by STD NMR showed binding of all fucosylated HMOs to GII.4 and GII.17 and none for non-fucosylated HMOs. In contrast, GII.2 showed little or no detectable binding under the same conditions. Seven crystal structures of GII.4 or GII.17 with complexed HMOs supported fucose anchoring via five conserved residues. The remaining sugar moieties formed genotype-specific secondary interactions with an extended, shallow and solvent exposed binding surface whose shape is dictated by divergent surface loops. GII.4 recognition is mainly driven by hydrogen bonds whereas GII.17 relied more strongly on water-mediated interactions. Chemical shift perturbation from NMR titrations (CSP NMR) of GII.4 corroborated the fucose interactions and gave dissociation constants of 20-33 mM, consistent with weak and rapidly exchanging interactions.
papers.translated_summary: 人诺如病毒是急性胃肠炎的主要病因。人乳寡糖（HMOs）含有与组织血型抗原相似的糖基基序，可能作为可溶性诱饵减少病毒附着。然而，不同诺如病毒基因型主要衣壳蛋白VP1的P结构域识别HMO的分子基础尚未完全阐明。在此，我们结合基于配体和基于蛋白质的NMR实验与X射线晶体学，研究了HMO与潜伏型GII.2、优势型GII.4和新出现GII.17诺如病毒基因型P结构域的结合。通过STD NMR对12种HMO的筛选显示，所有岩藻糖基化HMO均与GII.4和GII.17结合，而非岩藻糖基化HMO均不结合。相比之下，GII.2在相同条件下显示很少或检测不到结合。GII.4或GII.17与HMO复合的七个晶体结构支持岩藻糖通过五个保守残基进行锚定。其余糖基部分与延伸的、浅的且溶剂暴露的结合表面形成基因型特异性的次级相互作用，该表面的形状由不同的表面环决定。GII.4的识别主要由氢键驱动，而GII.17更强烈地依赖水介导的相互作用。GII.4的NMR滴定化学位移扰动（CSP NMR）证实了岩藻糖相互作用，并给出20-33 mM的解离常数，与弱且快速交换的相互作用一致。

papers.title: PREMISE: A Quality-Aware Probabilistic Framework for High-Resolution Source Assignment in Metagenomic Sequencing
papers.translated_title: 前提：一种用于宏基因组测序中高分辨率来源分配的质量感知概率框架
papers.author: Vijendran, S.
papers.summary: Metagenomic applications, from influenza A virus (IAV) subtype tracking to bacterial strain resolution, frequently require sub-species resolution.However, traditional $k$-mer-based methods fragment reads into short $k$-mers and discard per-base quality scores.By omitting both intra-read linkage and error information, these methods confound closely related genomic variants, thereby impeding real-time pathogen surveillance and containment.We introduce \premise (Pathogen Resolution via Expectation-Maximization In Sequencing Experiments), a probabilistic, alignment-based framework implemented in Rust for high-resolution source assignment against near-complete reference databases.\premise aligns whole reads using a bidirectional run-length FM-index and quantifies reference abundances with a quality-aware Expectation-Maximization algorithm mapped over a taxonomy.This framework applies an optional sparsity penalty to resolve ambiguous assignments, which is particularly important when sparse samples are mapped against reference databases rich in highly homologous candidate references.On ten dense CAMI II strain-madness samples, \premise achieves the highest species-level read classification F1 score ($0.992$) among eight evaluated methods, with no false-positive or missed species.At the strain level, \premise maps reads to their source genome with top precision ($0.80$ vs. at most $0.64$ for competing methods), achieves 100\% recall, and estimates abundances as accurately as the best competing tool.These results demonstrate \premise's ability to provide rigorous, uncertainty-aware source resolution across both dense and sparse metagenomes, accurately resolving targets ranging from viral subtypes to bacterial strains.\\textbf{Availability:} \url{https://github.com/sriram98v/premise} under an MIT license.\\textbf{Contact:} \href{sriramv@iastate.edu}{sriramv@iastate.edu}\\
papers.translated_summary: 宏基因组应用，从甲型流感病毒（IAV）亚型追踪到细菌菌株解析，经常需要亚种分辨率。然而，传统的基于$k$-mer的方法将reads片段化为短的$k$-mer并丢弃逐碱基质量分数。通过同时忽略read内连锁和错误信息，这些方法混淆了密切相关的基因组变异，从而阻碍了实时病原体监测和遏制。我们引入\premise（通过测序实验中的期望最大化进行病原体解析），这是一个用Rust实现的基于比对的概率框架，用于针对近乎完整的参考数据库进行高分辨率来源分配。\premise使用双向游程FM索引比对整个reads，并通过映射到分类学上的质量感知期望最大化算法量化参考丰度。该框架应用可选的稀疏性惩罚来解决模糊分配，这在稀疏样本映射到富含高度同源候选参考的参考数据库时尤为重要。在十个密集的CAMI II菌株疯狂样本上，\premise在八种评估方法中实现了最高的物种级read分类F1分数（$0.992$），没有假阳性或遗漏物种。在菌株水平上，\premise将reads映射到其来源基因组，具有最高精确度（$0.80$，而竞争方法至多为$0.64$），实现100\%召回率，并且丰度估计与最佳竞争工具一样准确。这些结果证明了\premise在密集和稀疏宏基因组中提供严格的、不确定性感知的来源解析的能力，准确解析从病毒亚型到细菌菌株的目标。\\textbf{可用性：} \url{https://github.com/sriram98v/premise}，MIT许可证。\\textbf{联系方式：} \href{sriramv@iastate.edu}{sriramv@iastate.edu}\\

papers.title: Mathematical model of phenotypic plasticity predicts interconversion is a drug target for neuroblastoma.
papers.translated_title: 表型可塑性的数学模型预测相互转化是神经母细胞瘤的药物靶点。
papers.author: Covell, F.
papers.summary: Neuroblastoma is a paediatric cancer arising from the sympathetic nervous system as neural crest cells, made up of noradrenergic (NOR/ADRN/N), mesenchymal like (MES/S), and intermediate (I-type/I) cell types. These cells can interconvert between types, contributing to treatment resistance and relapse. We developed a mathematical model to investigate how interconversion patterns affect the efficacy of phenotype-specific inhibitors. We used three ordinary differential equations to describe the dynamics of the three populations, including logistic growth, interconversion, and drug-induced death. Of the 64 possible interconversion patterns, five reduced the target population: two for N cells and three for S cells. N targeting patterns were more effective with higher interconversion rates, while mesenchymal targeting patterns were more effective with lower interconversion rates. Stability analysis revealed that natural tumour growth was always unstable, but during treatment, N-suppressing patterns combined with an S inhibitor gave the most consistently stable origin. Testing multi-stage and cyclic treatment schedules revealed that N-suppressing patterns with an S inhibitor, followed by an S-suppressing pattern with an N inhibitor, achieved more reliable remission. Three of the five patterns of interest correspond to reported biological plausibility, and known compounds exist to induce most of the required transitions, supporting the clinical relevance of these strategies for improving neuroblastoma treatment outcomes.
papers.translated_summary: 神经母细胞瘤是一种起源于交感神经系统的儿童癌症，由神经嵴细胞发展而来，包含去甲肾上腺素能（NOR/ADRN/N）、间充质样（MES/S）和中间型（I-type/I）细胞类型。这些细胞类型之间可以相互转化，从而导致治疗耐药和复发。我们建立了一个数学模型来研究相互转化模式如何影响表型特异性抑制剂的疗效。我们使用三个常微分方程来描述三种细胞群体的动态变化，包括逻辑斯谛生长、相互转化和药物诱导的死亡。在64种可能的相互转化模式中，有五种模式能够减少目标细胞群体：两种针对N细胞，三种针对S细胞。靶向N细胞的模式在相互转化率较高时更为有效，而靶向间充质细胞的模式在相互转化率较低时更为有效。稳定性分析揭示，自然肿瘤生长始终是不稳定的，但在治疗过程中，抑制N细胞的模式联合S细胞抑制剂能够给出最为持续稳定的原点。测试多阶段和循环治疗方案显示，先使用抑制N细胞的模式联合S细胞抑制剂，再使用抑制S细胞的模式联合N细胞抑制剂，能够实现更可靠的缓解。五种关注模式中有三种与已报道的生物学合理性相符，且已有已知化合物能够诱导大多数所需的转化，这支持了这些策略在改善神经母细胞瘤治疗预后方面的临床相关性。

papers.title: Residual Hearing Loss After Chronic Cochlear Implantation in Guinea Pigs is Primarily Conductive
papers.translated_title: 豚鼠长期人工耳蜗植入后的残余听力损失主要为传导性
papers.author: He, W.
papers.summary: It is desirous to preserve residual low-frequency hearing in cochlear implant recipients, as dual stimulation using electrical and acoustic signals results in superior speech-in-noise processing and musicality. However, cochlear implant recipients commonly lose their residual acoustic hearing gradually following surgical placement of the array. The governing mechanism is not understood and is likely due to multiple factors including surgical trauma, inflammation, and the foreign body induced immune response to the array, including formation of intracochlear fibrosis. Normal mechanical function of the cochlea is expected to underpin residual hearing but has not been directly studied. This function includes efficient transmission of sound to the cochlea via the middle ear, sound propagation via the basilar membrane travelling wave, mechanical tuning characteristics, and the non-linear cochlear amplification of responses to low-frequency stimulation. Here, we examined these features in cochleae and middle ears of unimplanted, acutely and chronically implanted guinea pigs using our minimally invasive preparation and optical coherence tomography vibrometry. We observed that mechanical tuning and amplification is not significantly altered by either acute or chronic implant. However, the response threshold was raised and proportional to middle ear responses. Additionally, the organ of Corti phase, and its sound intensity dependent changes, are unaltered by CI. Finally, a cluster analysis revealed sensitivity loss in chronically implanted animals is caused by middle ear dysfunction. Hence, in the guinea pig model, the dominant etiology of residual hearing loss is conductive. More research is required to establish whether residual hearing loss in humans similarly shares conductive elements.
papers.translated_summary: 在耳蜗植入者中保留残余低频听力是可取的，因为电声联合刺激能够带来更优的噪声中言语处理能力和音乐感知能力。然而，耳蜗植入者在阵列手术放置后通常会逐渐丧失其残余声学听力。其主导机制尚不清楚，可能由多种因素导致，包括手术创伤、炎症以及对阵列的外来异物诱导免疫反应，其中包括耳蜗内纤维化的形成。耳蜗的正常机械功能被认为是残余听力的基础，但尚未被直接研究。该功能包括声音通过中耳高效传递至耳蜗、通过基底膜行波进行声音传播、机械调谐特性，以及对低频刺激响应的非线性耳蜗放大。在此，我们使用微创制备和光学相干断层扫描振动测量技术，检查了未植入、急性和慢性植入豚鼠的耳蜗和中耳的这些特征。我们观察到，机械调谐和放大并未因急性或慢性植入而发生显著改变。然而，响应阈值升高，且与中耳响应成比例。此外，Corti器相位及其随声强变化的情况未受CI影响。最后，聚类分析显示，慢性植入动物的敏感性损失由中耳功能障碍引起。因此，在豚鼠模型中，残余听力损失的主导病因是传导性的。需要更多研究来确定人类的残余听力损失是否同样具有传导性成分。

papers.title: β-cell NCK1 is reduced in type 2 diabetes, impairing the unfolded protein response and insulin secretion while revealing sex-specific adaptation
papers.translated_title: 2型糖尿病中β细胞NCK1减少，损害未折叠蛋白反应和胰岛素分泌，同时揭示性别特异性适应
papers.author: Monteillet, L.
papers.summary: Type 2 diabetes is characterized by failure of pancreatic {beta} cells to adapt insulin secretion to metabolic demand, causing {beta} cell function and reduced {beta} cell mass. The unfolded protein response (UPR) is central to adaptation by maintaining endoplasmic reticulum homeostasis and supporting insulin biosynthesis, secretion, proliferation, and survival. NCK1, is an adaptor protein that regulates insulin biosynthesis and UPR activation, positioning it at the crossroads of several processes essential for {beta} cell function. We found in mouse and human islets that NCK1 expression was upregulated by glucose and reduced in individuals living with type 2 diabetes. We thus explored the importance of {beta} cell NCK1 in endocrine function and glucose homeostasis using INS 1 cells, mouse and human islets, and {beta} cell specific knockout male and female mice (NCK1{beta}KO). Loss of {beta} cell NCK1 disrupted the UPR and impaired insulin gene expression, insulin content, and glucose stimulated insulin secretion in vitro. Unexpectedly, these intrinsic {beta} cell defects triggered sex-specific adaptive responses at the organismal level, revealing distinct strategies to reshape glucose homeostasis. Under high fat/high sucrose diet, both NCK1{beta}KO female and male mice increased pancreatic insulin content, but females exhibited impaired insulin secretion associated with an increased number of small islets and reduced PERK pathway activation resulting in mild glucose intolerance. In contrast, males NCK1{beta}KO mice had improved insulin secretion associated with islet expansion, {beta} cell proliferation, and increased PERK pathway activation leading to enhanced glucose tolerance. These findings identify NCK1 as a regulator of {beta} cell insulin synthesis, secretion, and UPR signaling, and reveal sex specific adaptive mechanisms to metabolic stress. Thus, reduced NCK1 in islets from people living type 2 diabetes may contribute to {beta} cell dysfunction.
papers.translated_summary: 2型糖尿病的特征是胰腺β细胞无法使胰岛素分泌适应代谢需求，导致β细胞功能受损和β细胞质量减少。未折叠蛋白反应（UPR）通过维持内质网稳态和支持胰岛素生物合成、分泌、增殖及存活，在适应过程中发挥核心作用。NCK1是一种调节胰岛素生物合成和UPR激活的衔接蛋白，使其处于β细胞功能所必需的多个过程的交汇点。我们在小鼠和人类胰岛中发现，NCK1表达受葡萄糖上调，而在2型糖尿病患者中降低。因此，我们利用INS 1细胞、小鼠和人类胰岛以及β细胞特异性敲除雄性和雌性小鼠（NCK1βKO），探讨了β细胞NCK1在内分泌功能和葡萄糖稳态中的重要性。β细胞NCK1缺失破坏了UPR，并在体外损害了胰岛素基因表达、胰岛素含量和葡萄糖刺激的胰岛素分泌。出乎意料的是，这些β细胞内在缺陷在机体水平触发了性别特异性的适应性反应，揭示了重塑葡萄糖稳态的不同策略。在高脂/高蔗糖饮食下，NCK1βKO雌性和雄性小鼠均增加了胰腺胰岛素含量，但雌性表现出胰岛素分泌受损，伴有小胰岛数量增加和PERK通路激活减少，导致轻度葡萄糖不耐受。相反，雄性NCK1βKO小鼠表现出胰岛素分泌改善，伴有胰岛扩增、β细胞增殖和PERK通路激活增加，导致葡萄糖耐量增强。这些发现确定NCK1是β细胞胰岛素合成、分泌和UPR信号传导的调节因子，并揭示了应对代谢应激的性别特异性适应机制。因此，2型糖尿病患者胰岛中NCK1减少可能促进β细胞功能障碍。

papers.title: Secondary growth in the tomato stem is suppressed by the flowering regulators FUL2 and STM3
papers.translated_title: 番茄茎的次生生长受到开花调控因子FUL2和STM3的抑制
papers.author: Pandey, K.
papers.summary: Herbaceous eudicot crops such as tomato accumulate substantial amounts of secondary xylem in their stems, particularly in the basal part. As plants progress from the vegetative phase to flowering and fruit development, secondary growth continues to provide mechanical support and facilitate transport. To uncover how secondary growth is regulated in the tomato stem, we used laser capture microdissection RNA-seq to establish tissue-specific transcriptomic profiles. This revealed that key regulators associated with wood formation in poplar are also acting in tomato. Furthermore, we found that the flowering regulators FUL2 and STM3 are substantially expressed in xylem tissue. Subsequent functional analysis identified FUL2 and STM3 as key repressors of secondary growth, with ful2 or stm3 knock-out mutants exhibiting strongly increased secondary growth in older tomato stems. Notably, a higher order mutant in which both ful2 and stm3 were knocked out displays a similar non-additive phenotype, indicating, together with yeast two-hybrid data showing physical interaction, that FUL2 and STM3 act together in a complex. The expression levels of both genes remain low until after the floral transition but strongly rise during subsequent stem development. Transcriptomic analyses in ful2, stm3, and wild-type stems at stages before and after detectable anatomical differences, showed that the FUL2-STM3 complex represses distinct sets of NAC and MYB candidate regulators associated with xylem development. Interestingly, FUL2 and STM3 control these regulators in a stage- and position-dependent way, with candidates showing upregulation only at later stages in mid-height stems being already upregulated at earlier stages in basal stem regions. Our findings provide a tissue-resolved transcriptomic resource for tomato stems and reveal a role for FUL2 and STM3 in limiting secondary xylem accumulation as stem development progresses.
papers.translated_summary: 草本真双子叶作物如番茄在其茎中，尤其是基部，积累大量次生木质部。随着植物从营养阶段向开花和果实发育阶段推进，次生生长持续提供机械支撑并促进运输。为了揭示番茄茎中次生生长是如何被调控的，我们利用激光捕获显微切割RNA-seq建立了组织特异性转录组图谱。这揭示了与杨树木材形成相关的关键调控因子在番茄中也有作用。此外，我们发现开花调控因子FUL2和STM3在木质部组织中大量表达。随后的功能分析鉴定出FUL2和STM3是次生生长的关键抑制因子，ful2或stm3敲除突变体在较老番茄茎中表现出强烈增加的次生生长。值得注意的是，同时敲除ful2和stm3的高阶突变体显示出类似的非加性表型，结合酵母双杂交数据显示的物理相互作用，表明FUL2和STM3在一个复合体中共同作用。这两个基因的表达水平在花转变之前一直保持较低，但在随后的茎发育过程中强烈上升。在可检测到解剖学差异之前和之后阶段对ful2、stm3和野生型茎的转录组分析表明，FUL2-STM3复合体抑制与木质部发育相关的不同NAC和MYB候选调控因子集。有趣的是，FUL2和STM3以阶段和位置依赖的方式控制这些调控因子，仅在中高茎的后期阶段上调的候选因子在基部茎区的早期阶段就已经上调。我们的发现为番茄茎提供了组织分辨的转录组资源，并揭示了FUL2和STM3在茎发育进程中限制次生木质部积累的作用。

papers.title: A three-factor model can explain symmetry breaking and the n-1 rule during X-chromosome inactivation
papers.translated_title: 三因子模型可以解释X染色体失活过程中的对称性破缺和n-1规则
papers.author: Guan, K.
papers.summary: X-chromosome inactivation (XCI) is a mammalian gene regulatory process that via chromosome-scale transcriptional silencing, leaves active a single X chromosome per diploid genome complement. The mechanisms that enable cells to select the appropriate number of X chromosomes to inactivate while leaving others active remain unclear. We demonstrate that all known chromosomal counting scenarios during XCI can be accounted for by a three-factor mathematical model that includes (1) Xist, the long noncoding RNA (lncRNA) responsible for gene silencing during XCI in eutherians, (2) an X-linked transcriptional activator of Xist, and (3) the autosomally-encoded SPEN, an Xist RNA-binding protein that is essential for gene silencing during XCI. In our model, symmetry between active X chromosomes is broken by stochastic differences in the number of Xist molecules that associate with the X chromosomes at the onset of XCI. Subsequently, integrated positive and negative feedback loops amplify then propagate superstoichiometric assemblies of SPEN complexed with Xist on the inactive chromosome(s), and select for levels of X-linked activator that enable only one X chromosome per diploid genome complement to remain active. Thus, asymmetric propagation of the SPEN-Xist ribonucleoprotein complex may play an essential role in symmetry breaking and chromosomal counting during XCI, independently of or in concert with cis-acting networks of DNA regulatory elements. Our results also have conceptual implications for gene regulatory circuits on autosomes.
papers.translated_summary: X染色体失活（XCI）是一种哺乳动物基因调控过程，通过染色体规模的转录沉默，使二倍体基因组补体中仅保留一条X染色体处于活跃状态。细胞如何在失活适当数量的X染色体的同时保持其他X染色体活跃的机制仍不清楚。我们证明，XCI过程中所有已知的染色体计数情景均可由一个三因子数学模型解释，该模型包括：（1）Xist，即真兽类XCI过程中负责基因沉默的长非编码RNA（lncRNA）；（2）Xist的X连锁转录激活因子；（3）常染色体编码的SPEN，一种Xist RNA结合蛋白，对XCI过程中的基因沉默至关重要。在我们的模型中，活跃X染色体之间的对称性被XCI起始时与X染色体结合的Xist分子数量的随机差异所打破。随后，整合的正负反馈环路放大并传播失活染色体上SPEN与Xist复合形成的超化学计量组装体，并筛选X连锁激活因子的水平，使得每个二倍体基因组补体中仅有一条X染色体保持活跃。因此，SPEN-Xist核糖核蛋白复合体的不对称传播可能在XCI过程中的对称性打破和染色体计数中发挥重要作用，其作用独立于或协同于DNA调控元件的顺式作用网络。我们的结果对常染色体上的基因调控回路也具有概念性意义。

papers.title: Auditory Evoked Potentials Differ from Controls and Correlate with Aspects of Cognition in Kabuki Syndrome and Rubinstein-Taybi Syndrome
papers.translated_title: 听觉诱发电位在歌舞伎综合征和鲁宾斯坦-泰比综合征中与对照组不同，并与认知的某些方面相关
papers.author: Kalinousky, A.
papers.summary: Objective Kabuki syndrome (KS) and Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome (RSTS) are two disorders caused by dysfunctional components of the epigenetic machinery and both result in intellectual disability. Mouse models of both KS and RSTS have seen reversal of cognitive impairment with epigenetic treatments. However, a great need exists for biomarkers in these disorders to improve the likelihood of successful clinical trials. This study aimed to investigate cortical auditory evoked potentials (AEPs) in KS and RSTS so that it could potentially be developed into a response biomarker in the future. Methods The amplitude of the N1-P2-N2 complex was measured for passive listening to monotonal auditory stimuli in individuals with KS, with RSTS, and typically developing controls. A standardized cognitive assessment battery was performed and specific subtests were correlated with AEP values. Results Groups differed significantly in P2, N2, and P2-N2 amplitude although RSTS was consistently more different from typically developing controls than was KS. The mid- to late-phase AEP components (P2 and N2) also correlate with cognition within and across these groups particularly with language whereas earlier components N1 and P2 correlate more with measures of executive functioning. Conclusion Late-phase components of AEPs differ in KS and RSTS from each other and from controls. KS and RSTS differ from controls in P2 and N2 amplitude in the same direction and both show a positive correlation between language and P2 amplitude and a negative correlation between language and N2 amplitude. Together they also show an association with N1 and P2 amplitude and executive functioning. Significance AEPs may turn out to be a valuable response biomarker in KS and RSTS individually and together.
papers.translated_summary: 目的 Kabuki综合征（KS）和Rubinstein-Taybi综合征（RSTS）是由表观遗传机制组分功能障碍引起的两种疾病，均可导致智力障碍。KS和RSTS的小鼠模型已通过表观遗传治疗实现认知障碍的逆转。然而，这些疾病亟需生物标志物以提高临床试验成功的可能性。本研究旨在探究KS和RSTS患者的皮层听觉诱发电位（AEPs），以期未来将其开发为反应生物标志物。方法 测量KS患者、RSTS患者及典型发育对照组在被动聆听单音听觉刺激时的N1-P2-N2复合波幅。进行标准化认知评估 battery，并将特定分测验与AEP值进行相关性分析。结果 各组在P2、N2及P2-N2波幅上存在显著差异，其中RSTS与典型发育对照组的差异始终大于KS。中晚期AEP成分（P2和N2）在这些组内及组间均与认知相关，尤其是与语言相关，而早期成分N1和P2则更多与执行功能测量相关。结论 KS和RSTS的晚期AEP成分彼此不同，且均与对照组不同。KS和RSTS在P2和N2波幅上与对照组差异方向相同，且两者均显示语言与P2波幅呈正相关、语言与N2波幅呈负相关。两者合并分析还显示与N1和P2波幅及执行功能存在关联。意义 AEPs可能成为KS和RSTS单独及联合应用中有价值的反应生物标志物。

papers.title: Multi-agent LLM teams improve differential recall on curated cases but underperform on emergency working-label matching: a two-cohort, two-family evaluation
papers.translated_title: 多智能体大语言模型团队在精选病例上提高了鉴别诊断召回率，但在急诊工作标签匹配上表现不佳：一项双队列、双模型家族评估
papers.author: Feng, J.
papers.summary: Background. Whether multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines help, add nothing, or underperform a single call may depend on the input and scoring contract rather than the architecture; these boundary conditions are unmapped. Methods. We compared a single direct call (Ax1), five personas in one context (P), and five isolated roles integrated by a moderator (MDT) across curated corpora (87 clinicopathological cases, 406 MedCaseReasoning cases, 392 replication vignettes) and two disjoint emergency cohorts from one repository (364 mixed-label encounters; a protocol-frozen 400-encounter disease-label-only replacement, one local serving stack). Scoring was judge-mediated top-k working-label matching. A completed factorial isolated the active ingredient; a symptom-permissive output-contract arm tested contract fit; three physicians rated discordant cases. Findings. On curated corpora MDT improved differential-list recall (top-3: +5.5 points, p = 0.0079; +3.0, p = 0.0079; +3.3, p = 0.0013) but not top-1 accuracy; the factorial attributed the gain to independent generation plus moderated synthesis, not personas. On emergency presentations the sign reversed: in the disease-label-only cohort Ax1 led MDT at every endpoint (top-3 -5.2 points, 95% CI -8.0 to -2.4, p = 0.0008), a second family reproduced it, and bridged cases excluded the serving stack. A symptom-permissive contract shrank the deficit's point estimates by 52-75%, replacement-cohort intervals all spanning zero though remaining negative; the clause harmed no arm. Physician safety ratings were inconclusive (original-cohort gate missed; replacement-cohort rescue contrast unadjudicable, 95% CI -32.7 to +2.6). Interpretation. Multi-agent diagnostic gains are real but conditional: the sign of the effect tracks input genre, and its magnitude tracks output-contract fit. Curated-benchmark gains should not be extrapolated to first-contact emergency text, where role-based teams underperform a single call at seven-fold token cost. The reversal is label-level and judge-mediated; clinical safety is neither established nor excluded.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。多智能体大语言模型（LLM）流水线究竟是有帮助、毫无增益，还是不如单次调用，可能取决于输入与评分契约而非架构；这些边界条件尚未被刻画。方法。我们在精选语料库（87 例临床病理病例、406 例 MedCaseReasoning 病例、392 个复现短病例）以及来自同一数据仓库的两个不相交急诊队列（364 例混合标签就诊；一个协议冻结的 400 例仅疾病标签替代队列，单一本地服务栈）上，比较了单次直接调用（Ax1）、单一上下文中的五个角色（P），以及由主持人整合的五个隔离角色（MDT）。评分采用裁判介导的 top-k 工作标签匹配。一项已完成的析因实验分离出有效成分；一个症状宽松的输出契约分支检验了契约契合度；三名医生对不一致病例进行了评分。发现。在精选语料库上，MDT 改善了鉴别诊断列表召回率（top-3：+5.5 个百分点，p = 0.0079；+3.0，p = 0.0079；+3.3，p = 0.0013），但未改善 top-1 准确率；析因实验将增益归因于独立生成加主持人整合，而非角色设定。在急诊就诊表现上，符号反转：在仅疾病标签队列中，Ax1 在每个终点均领先 MDT（top-3 -5.2 个百分点，95% CI -8.0 至 -2.4，p = 0.0008），第二个模型家族复现了该结果，桥接病例排除了服务栈的影响。症状宽松契约使缺陷的点估计缩小了 52-75%，替代队列的区间均跨越零但仍为负；该条款未损害任何分支。医生安全评分无定论（原始队列门槛未通过；替代队列救援对比无法裁定，95% CI -32.7 至 +2.6）。解释。多智能体诊断增益真实存在但有条件：效应符号随输入体裁而变化，其幅度随输出契约契合度而变化。精选基准上的增益不应外推到首诊急诊文本，在此类场景中基于角色的团队以七倍 token 成本却不如单次调用。该反转是标签层面且由裁判介导的；临床安全性既未确立也未排除。

papers.title: Beyond Perinatal Mood: Breadth of Psychiatric Symptoms and Delay Discounting as Correlates of Mothers' Relational Reports from Pregnancy Through Adult Children
papers.translated_title: 超越围产期情绪：精神症状的广度与延迟折扣作为母亲从孕期到成年子女关系报告的相关因素
papers.author: DeLauder, R.
papers.summary: Maternal mental illness affects roughly one in five mothers in the United States, yet most evidence linking it to the mother-child relationship comes from the first postpartum year and relies on self-report measures of depression, anxiety, and stress. In 613 women spanning five family contexts - pregnancy and mothers whose youngest child was aged 0-2, 3-12, 13-17, or 18 and older - we examined twelve psychological constructs as correlates of mothers' relational reports. Eleven were associated with relational reports individually; entered together, only three retained independent associations surviving false discovery rate correction: cross-domain psychiatric symptom burden (beta = 0.38), delay discounting (beta = -0.11), and orienting sensitivity (beta = 0.10). To our knowledge, this is the first peer-reviewed study linking delay discounting to maternal relational reports. Depression, anxiety, anger, perceived stress, and negative affect fell to non-significance, and the symptom composite that displaced them contains none of those domains, indicating that breadth of psychiatric symptoms, not their type, tracked relational reports. A person-centered analysis converged: the latent profile with the poorest relational reports was defined by symptoms across multiple domains rather than by elevated stress alone. Associations varied across family contexts, though because each context used a different relational instrument, differences cannot be attributed to child age. These cross-sectional findings suggest that the psychological dimension most closely tied to maternal relational reports is broader than the perinatal mood constructs around which research and screening are organized, and that cross-domain symptom assessment warrants prospective evaluation as a complement to mood screening.
papers.translated_summary: 在美国，约五分之一的母亲受到孕产妇精神疾病的影响，然而大多数将其与母子关系联系起来的证据来自产后第一年，并且依赖于对抑郁、焦虑和压力的自我报告测量。在涵盖五种家庭情境的613名女性中——包括孕期以及最小子女年龄为0-2岁、3-12岁、13-17岁或18岁及以上的母亲——我们考察了十二种心理构念与母亲关系报告的相关性。其中十一种构念单独与关系报告相关；同时纳入分析后，仅三种构念在经错误发现率校正后仍保留独立关联：跨领域精神症状负担（beta = 0.38）、延迟折扣（beta = -0.11）和定向敏感性（beta = 0.10）。据我们所知，这是首个将延迟折扣与母亲关系报告联系起来的同行评审研究。抑郁、焦虑、愤怒、感知压力和负性情绪均降至不显著，而取代它们症状复合变量不包含上述任何领域，表明与关系报告相关的是精神症状的广度而非其类型。以人为中心的分析结果一致：关系报告最差的潜在剖面由跨多个领域的症状所定义，而非仅由压力升高所定义。关联在不同家庭情境中存在差异，但由于每种情境使用了不同的关系测量工具，差异不能归因于子女年龄。这些横断面研究结果表明，与母亲关系报告联系最紧密的心理维度比研究和筛查所围绕的围产期情绪构念更为广泛，跨领域症状评估值得作为情绪筛查的补充进行前瞻性评估。

papers.title: Individualised and Time-Dependent Prediction of Recurrence After Colorectal Cancer Liver Metastases Resection
papers.translated_title: 结直肠癌肝转移切除术后复发的个体化及时间依赖性预测
papers.author: Viljamaa, A.
papers.summary: Introduction: Treatment strategies for colorectal cancer liver metastases (CRLM) are increasingly complex, driving interest in advanced prognostic tools. Externally validated benchmarks based on established clinical risk scores are needed to contextualise emerging models. However, existing scores remain difficult to apply and compare, because they provide categorical risk strata rather than individualised probabilities, and because model parameters are rarely published. Here, we validate and recalibrate seven established risk scores to derive individualised recurrence probabilities for future score benchmarking. Method: Patients undergoing index CRLM resection from two tertiary centres were included: Karolinska University Hospital (retrospective KaroLiver cohort [2013-2021, follow-up to 2025, n=709]) and Oslo University Hospital (OSLO-COMET trial cohort [2012-2016, follow-up to 2022, n=198]). Performance of the GAME, m-CS, Fong, Nordlinger, Nagashima, Konopke and Helsinki scores was assessed using recurrence-free survival as the primary outcome. Results: Among 709 patients in KaroLiver (median age 67 years [IQR 59-74]; 434 men [61%]), 422 (60%) had synchronous metastases and 444 (63%) received neoadjuvant chemotherapy. All scores significantly stratified recurrence risk (log-rank P<0.001; time-dependent AUC 0.63-0.74 at 3 years), albeit with performance differences across time points. Recalibrated models showed good agreement between predicted and observed recurrence and were externally validated in OSLO-COMET with broadly comparable net benefit. Models were implemented in the online tool PLATO (Personalised Liver metastases risk AssessmenT in Oncology). Conclusion: Established CRLM risk scores can be translated into individualised probabilistic recurrence estimates at clinically relevant time points, supporting patient communication, risk-adapted surveillance and transparent benchmarking of next-generation prognostic models.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：结直肠癌肝转移（CRLM）的治疗策略日益复杂，推动了人们对先进预后工具的关注。需要基于既有临床风险评分的外部验证基准，为新兴模型提供参照背景。然而，现有评分仍难以应用和比较，因为它们提供的是分类风险分层而非个体化概率，且模型参数很少公开发表。在此，我们验证并重新校准了七种既有风险评分，以推导个体化复发概率，供未来评分基准测试使用。方法：纳入来自两个三级中心的初次CRLM切除患者：卡罗林斯卡大学医院（回顾性KaroLiver队列[2013-2021年，随访至2025年，n=709]）和奥斯陆大学医院（OSLO-COMET试验队列[2012-2016年，随访至2022年，n=198]）。以无复发生存作为主要结局，评估GAME、m-CS、Fong、Nordlinger、Nagashima、Konopke和Helsinki评分的性能。结果：在KaroLiver的709例患者中（中位年龄67岁[IQR 59-74]；男性434例[61%]），422例（60%）伴有同时性转移，444例（63%）接受了新辅助化疗。所有评分均能显著分层复发风险（log-rank P<0.001；3年时时间依赖AUC 0.63-0.74），尽管不同时间点的性能存在差异。重新校准的模型显示预测复发与观察复发之间具有良好一致性，并在OSLO-COMET中进行了外部验证，净获益大体相当。模型已实现在在线工具PLATO（Personalised Liver metastases risk AssessmenT in Oncology）中。结论：既有CRLM风险评分可转化为临床相关时间点的个体化概率性复发估计，支持患者沟通、风险适应性监测以及下一代预后模型的透明基准测试。

papers.title: PlanetDiet: Sustainable diets and cardiometabolic health, study protocol for a six-month parallel-group randomized controlled trial in middle-aged adults at cardiovascular risk
papers.translated_title: PlanetDiet：可持续饮食与心脏代谢健康，一项为期六个月、在心血管风险中年成人中开展的平行组随机对照试验研究方案
papers.author: Trius-Soler, M.
papers.summary: Background: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) remains the leading cause of death worldwide. Diet plays a key role in CVD prevention while linking human health with environmental sustainability. The EAT-Lancet Commission proposed the Planetary Health Diet (PHD), a predominantly plant-based dietary pattern emphasizing high-quality foods and reduced meat consumption. Despite growing interest in the PHD, no randomized controlled trial (RCT) has evaluated its effects using the PHD index on established and novel cardiometabolic biomarkers. Methods: The PlanetDiet study is a six-month, three-arm parallel RCT investigating the effects of sustainable diets on traditional and novel cardiometabolic risk factors in 180 Danish adults aged 45?70 years at high cardiovascular risk. Participants are randomized to a PHD, an ovo-lacto-vegetarian diet, or their habitual diet (control). The primary outcome is changes in a composite cardiometabolic health score, with secondary outcomes including changes in metabolomic and proteomic profiles. Clinical assessments include the analysis of urine, blood, and faecal samples; continuous glucose monitoring; anthropometry and body composition measurements; dietary records; and self-reported questionnaires assessing physical activity, quality of life and dietary acceptance. To support adherence, participants receive four individualized dietary counselling sessions, two group sessions, seasonal food boxes tailored to their assigned diet, and access to a personalized digital application with recipes, individualized timelines, and visit scheduling. Conclusions: PlanetDiet will provide evidence on the effects of sustainable dietary patterns on cardiometabolic health. It will also investigate molecular pathways linking diet to cardiometabolic disease. Ultimately, the study may inform the development of effective, personalized dietary interventions that promote both human and planetary health. Trial registration: Sustainable Diets and Cardiometabolic Health (PlanetDiet): NCT07189676 [ClinicalTrials.gov] [registered before inclusion start; 2025-09-15]; Unique identifier: H-25030722.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：心血管疾病（CVD）仍是全球主要死因。饮食在CVD预防中发挥关键作用，同时将人类健康与环境可持续性联系起来。EAT-Lancet委员会提出了行星健康饮食（PHD），这是一种以植物性食物为主的饮食模式，强调高质量食物并减少肉类消费。尽管对PHD的兴趣日益增长，但尚无随机对照试验（RCT）使用PHD指数评估其对已确立的和新型心脏代谢生物标志物的影响。方法：PlanetDiet研究是一项为期六个月、三臂平行RCT，旨在研究可持续饮食对180名年龄45?70岁、心血管高风险丹麦成年人的传统和新型心脏代谢危险因素的影响。参与者被随机分配至PHD、蛋奶素食或习惯饮食（对照）组。主要结局是复合心脏代谢健康评分的变化，次要结局包括代谢组学和蛋白质组学谱的变化。临床评估包括尿液、血液和粪便样本分析；连续血糖监测；人体测量学和身体成分测量；饮食记录；以及评估身体活动、生活质量和饮食接受度的自报问卷。为提高依从性，参与者接受四次个体化饮食咨询、两次小组咨询、根据其分配饮食定制的季节性食物盒，以及一个包含食谱、个体化时间线和访视预约的个性化数字应用程序。结论：PlanetDiet将提供关于可持续饮食模式对心脏代谢健康影响的证据。该研究还将探讨连接饮食与心脏代谢疾病的分子通路。最终，该研究可能为制定促进人类和地球健康的有效、个性化饮食干预措施提供信息。试验注册：可持续饮食与心脏代谢健康（PlanetDiet）：NCT07189676 [ClinicalTrials.gov] [纳入开始前注册；2025-09-15]；唯一标识符：H-25030722。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Wearable and Biological Data Integration Reveals Physiological Signatures of Weight Variation in Overweight and Obese Adults: An AI4Food Machine Learning Study
papers.translated_title: 多模态可穿戴与生物数据整合揭示超重和肥胖成人群体重变化生理特征：一项AI4Food机器学习研究
papers.author: Attioui, H.
papers.summary: This study is part of the AI4Food project, which aims to identify the physiological and behavioral factors influencing weight variation in overweight and obese individuals through integrative analysis of multi-source data. A 30-day crossover intervention was conducted on 93 participants at IMDEA Nutrition Institute, combining a traditional phase (questionnaires, food diaries) and a digital phase (Fitbit Sense Smartwatch, FreeStyle Libre 2 glucose sensor). The collected data encompassed sleep, glucose, skin temperature, nutrition, and gut microbiome information. After rigorous preprocessing and alignment by intervention days, unsupervised clustering, association analysis, and machine learning models were applied to uncover physiological patterns linked to weight dynamics. Results showed greater weight reduction during the digital phase in Group 2, while between-group differences were not significant. Significant associations were observed between nocturnal respiratory rate, skin temperature, and weight variation. Under participant-level five-fold cross-validation, Random Forest models achieved mean accuracies of 64.3% for thermoregulation and 61.7% for glucose phenotype prediction, with RMSSD, restlessness, and nocturnal respiratory rate among the most influential predictors. In contrast, microbiome composition remained almost stable over the short intervention period. These findings support the potential of AI-driven integration of wearable and nutritional data to stratify metabolic phenotypes and advance personalized nutrition strategies in obesity management.
papers.translated_summary: 本研究是AI4Food项目的一部分，该项目旨在通过多源数据的整合分析，识别影响超重和肥胖个体体重变化的生理和行为因素。研究在IMDEA营养研究所对93名参与者开展了为期30天的交叉干预，结合了传统阶段（问卷、食物日记）和数字阶段（Fitbit Sense智能手表、FreeStyle Libre 2葡萄糖传感器）。所收集的数据涵盖睡眠、葡萄糖、皮肤温度、营养和肠道微生物组信息。经过严格预处理并按干预天数对齐后，应用无监督聚类、关联分析和机器学习模型，以揭示与体重动态相关的生理模式。结果显示，第2组在数字阶段体重下降幅度更大，但组间差异不显著。夜间呼吸频率、皮肤温度与体重变化之间观察到显著关联。在参与者级别的五折交叉验证下，随机森林模型在体温调节方面的平均准确率达到64.3%，在葡萄糖表型预测方面达到61.7%，其中RMSSD、不安度和夜间呼吸频率是最具影响力的预测因子。相比之下，微生物组组成在短期干预期间几乎保持稳定。这些发现支持了AI驱动的可穿戴设备与营养数据整合在代谢表型分层以及推进肥胖管理个性化营养策略方面的潜力。

papers.title: KNOWLEDGE, ATTITUDES AND PRACTICES OF REFUSE DISPOSAL IN OKELELE, ILORIN, NIGERIA
papers.translated_title: 尼日利亚伊洛林奥凯莱莱的垃圾处理知识、态度与实践
papers.author: IBRAHIM, M.
papers.summary: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Improper refuse disposal remains an environmental health concern in many Nigerian communities. This study assessed knowledge, attitudes and practices relating to refuse disposal among adult residents of Okelele community, Ilorin East Local Government Area, Kwara State, Nigeria. METHODS: A descriptive cross-sectional community-based study was conducted among 180 adults. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire covering sociodemographic characteristics, knowledge, attitudes and disposal practices. Descriptive statistics summarised responses, and chi-square tests assessed associations between categorical variables at a 5% significance level. RESULTS: Of 180 respondents, 102 (56.7%) had good knowledge, while 87 (48.3%) had negative attitudes and 99 (55.0%) had poor refuse-disposal practices. Commonly reported practices included incineration (50.6%), disposal into drains (30.6%) and open burning (21.7%). Absence of waste containers (37.2%) and distance to available containers (28.9%) were the leading reported barriers. Knowledge was associated with practice (chi-square=22.122; p<0.001) and attitude (chi-square=8.221; p=0.016); practice was also associated with attitude (chi-square=5.970; p=0.015). CONCLUSION AND IMPLICATIONS FOR TRANSLATION: Despite generally good knowledge, poor disposal practices were common. Improving access to reliable waste-collection infrastructure, alongside community education and enforcement of local waste-management measures, may help translate knowledge into safer practices. Keywords: Solid waste; Waste management; Knowledge; Attitude; Health behavior; Nigeria
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目标：不当的垃圾处理仍然是尼日利亚许多社区的环境健康问题。本研究评估了尼日利亚夸拉州伊洛林东地方政府区奥凯莱莱社区成年居民对垃圾处理的知识、态度和实践。方法：在180名成年人中开展了一项描述性横断面社区研究。数据通过结构化问卷收集，涵盖社会人口学特征、知识、态度和处理实践。描述性统计对回答进行汇总，卡方检验在5%显著性水平下评估分类变量之间的关联。结果：在180名受访者中，102人（56.7%）具有良好知识，而87人（48.3%）持消极态度，99人（55.0%）的垃圾处理实践较差。常见报告的做法包括焚烧（50.6%）、排入下水道（30.6%）和露天燃烧（21.7%）。缺乏垃圾容器（37.2%）和到可用容器的距离（28.9%）是报告的主要障碍。知识与实践相关（卡方=22.122；p<0.001）且与态度相关（卡方=8.221；p=0.016）；实践也与态度相关（卡方=5.970；p=0.015）。结论及对转化的启示：尽管知识总体良好，但不良处理实践十分普遍。改善获得可靠垃圾收集基础设施的机会，同时开展社区教育并执行地方废物管理措施，可能有助于将知识转化为更安全的实践。关键词：固体废物；废物管理；知识；态度；健康行为；尼日利亚

papers.title: Time at the curb, not the rate of head scanning, distinguishes street crossing in virtual reality with severe-to-profound visual impairment
papers.translated_title: 在严重至深度视觉障碍的情况下，虚拟现实中的过街表现取决于路缘停留时间，而非头部扫视速率。
papers.author: Erkat-Cohen, B.
papers.summary: Purpose: We tested whether people with severe-to-profound visual impairment compensate at street crossings with more head scanning and/or more time at the curb. Methods: Ten normally sighted controls, tested with normal vision and with Bangerter filters simulating severe-to-profound visual impairment (approximately 20/2000), and 17 adults with severe-to-profound visual impairment crossed a virtual street in a head-mounted display. Four complexity levels ranged from an empty street to yielding vehicles with pedestrian avatars; only the two most complex levels contained moving vehicles. Cumulative absolute head yaw and latency to step-off were analyzed with mixed-effects models, and latencies were fitted with an ex-Gaussian distribution. Results: Compared with normal vision, latency to step-off was 1.57 times longer with simulated and 1.82 times longer with clinical severe-to-profound visual impairment (Bonferroni p < 0.001 and p = 0.008, respectively). In severe-to-profound visual impairment, the additional latency was attributable to the slow tail of the latency distribution (exponential component {tau} longer by 3.40 s without and 6.20 s with moving vehicles; Bonferroni p = 0.037 and 0.022, respectively); peak position did not differ significantly. Before step-off, cumulative absolute head yaw increased with complexity, F(3, 115.8) = 37.16, p < 0.001, and was 1.88 times higher with simulated impairment than with normal vision (Bonferroni p = 0.024); it did not differ significantly between clinical impairment and normal vision, either before step-off or during walking (both Bonferroni p [≥] 0.479). During walking, its increase with complexity depended on viewing condition, F(6, 109.3) = 5.23, p < 0.001. Conclusions: Severe-to-profound visual impairment was associated with longer and more variable time at the curb, without a significant increase in cumulative head scanning, although the increase in head scanning with complexity during walking was attenuated. Time at the curb is relevant to orientation and mobility practice and accessible crossing design.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：我们测试了严重至深度视觉障碍者是否在过街时通过更多的头部扫视和/或在路缘停留更长时间来进行补偿。方法：十名视力正常的对照者，在正常视力下以及使用Bangerter滤光片模拟严重至深度视觉障碍（约20/2000）的条件下接受测试；另有17名患有严重至深度视觉障碍的成年人在头戴式显示器中穿越虚拟街道。四种复杂度水平从空街道到有行人化身的让行车辆不等；只有两个最复杂的水平包含移动车辆。使用混合效应模型分析累积绝对头部偏航角和起步潜伏期，并对潜伏期拟合指数-高斯分布。结果：与正常视力相比，模拟严重至深度视觉障碍下起步潜伏期延长1.57倍，临床严重至深度视觉障碍下延长1.82倍（Bonferroni p < 0.001和p = 0.008）。在严重至深度视觉障碍中，额外的潜伏期可归因于潜伏期分布的慢尾（指数成分{tau}在无移动车辆时延长3.40秒，有移动车辆时延长6.20秒；Bonferroni p = 0.037和0.022）；峰值位置无显著差异。起步前，累积绝对头部偏航角随复杂度增加而增大，F(3, 115.8) = 37.16，p < 0.001，且模拟障碍下比正常视力高1.88倍（Bonferroni p = 0.024）；临床障碍与正常视力之间在起步前或行走期间均无显著差异（Bonferroni p [≥] 0.479）。行走期间，其随复杂度的增加取决于观看条件，F(6, 109.3) = 5.23，p < 0.001。结论：严重至深度视觉障碍与更长且更多变的路缘停留时间相关，而累积头部扫视无显著增加，尽管行走期间头部扫视随复杂度的增加有所减弱。路缘停留时间与定向和移动实践及无障碍过街设计相关。

papers.title: Co-Design of the VIRtual physiotherapist-led Triage of referrals to shoUlder surgEons (VIRTUE) model of care: a study protocol
papers.translated_title: 虚拟物理治疗师主导的肩部外科医生转诊分诊（VIRTUE）照护模式的协同设计：一项研究方案
papers.author: Gamble, A. R.
papers.summary: Background: Rotator cuff-related shoulder pain accounts for up to 85% of shoulder pain. Guidelines recommend 6 months of non-surgical care before considering surgery, yet many are referred to a surgeon before trying it. High referral rates to public hospital shoulder surgery clinics in Australia mean many patients wait 1-2 years to see a surgeon, during which symptoms may become more complex and costly to manage. A promising solution is the VIRtual physiotherapist-led Triage of referrals to shoUlder surgEons (VIRTUE) model of care, in which physiotherapists screen new referrals and determine suitability for non-surgical care or surgical review. However, no such model has been co-designed to incorporate virtual care nor evaluated in a randomised controlled trial. Aims: The broad aim of this study is to co-design the VIRTUE model of care ready for evaluation in a randomised controlled trial conducted in public hospital shoulder surgery clinics in Australia. Specifically, this study has two aims (two stages): i) explore stakeholders perceptions of the feasibility, acceptability and implementation of the VIRTUE model of care for adults with rotator cuff-related shoulder pain who are referred to public hospital shoulder surgery clinics; and ii) co-design the VIRTUE model of care so that it is user-centred and acceptable to patients, clinicians and key stakeholders. Methods: Stage 1 is a qualitative descriptive study using semi-structured online interviews with patients, clinicians and key stakeholders, recruited using purposive, maximum variation sampling. Interviews will explore experiences of current care, perceptions of the proposed model, and barriers and facilitators to implementation, guided by the Theoretical Framework for Acceptability and Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research. Stage 2 will use Experience-Based Co-Design methodology and involves three online workshops: separate workshops for patients, and for clinicians and key stakeholders, then a combined workshop. Workshops will explore Stage 1 findings, perceptions of the proposed model, and refinements needed to finalise it, with data mapped to the Framework for Reporting Adaptations and Modifications-Expanded. Conclusion: Co-designing VIRTUE with patients, clinicians and key stakeholders will ensure it is user-centred, acceptable and feasible within Australian public health services, ready for evaluation in a randomised controlled trial. By facilitating timely and equitable access to evidence-based care, VIRTUE could improve outcomes for patients, ensure specialist services are available for those most in need, and improve health system performance.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：肩袖相关肩痛占肩痛的比例高达85%。指南建议在考虑手术前先进行6个月的非手术治疗，但许多患者在尝试非手术治疗之前就被转诊至外科医生。澳大利亚公立医院肩部手术诊所的转诊率高，意味着许多患者需要等待1至2年才能见到外科医生，在此期间症状可能变得更加复杂，管理成本也更高。一种有前景的解决方案是VIRTUE（虚拟物理治疗师主导的肩部外科医生转诊分诊）照护模式，即由物理治疗师筛查新转诊患者，判断其适合非手术照护还是手术评估。然而，目前尚无此类模式经过共同设计以纳入虚拟照护，也未经随机对照试验评估。目的：本研究的总体目标是共同设计VIRTUE照护模式，使其能够在澳大利亚公立医院肩部手术诊所开展的随机对照试验中进行评估。具体而言，本研究有两个目标（两个阶段）：i）探讨利益相关者对VIRTUE照护模式的可接受性、可行性和实施情况的看法，该模式面向因肩袖相关肩痛被转诊至公立医院肩部手术诊所的成人患者；ii）共同设计VIRTUE照护模式，使其以用户为中心，并为患者、临床医生和关键利益相关者所接受。方法：第1阶段为定性描述性研究，采用半结构化在线访谈，访谈对象为患者、临床医生和关键利益相关者，通过目的性最大变异抽样招募。访谈将在可接受性理论框架和实施研究整合框架的指导下，探讨当前照护体验、对所提模式的看法以及实施的障碍和促进因素。第2阶段将采用基于经验的共同设计方法，包括三次在线工作坊：分别为患者和临床医生及关键利益相关者举办单独的工作坊，然后举办一次联合工作坊。工作坊将探讨第1阶段的发现、对所提模式的看法以及最终确定该模式所需的改进，数据将映射至适应与修改报告框架扩展版。结论：与患者、临床医生和关键利益相关者共同设计VIRTUE，将确保其以用户为中心、可接受且在澳大利亚公共卫生服务中可行，并准备好接受随机对照试验评估。通过促进及时、公平地获得循证照护，VIRTUE可以改善患者结局，确保最需要的人群能够获得专科服务，并提升卫生系统绩效。

papers.title: Sex, age and HIV-1 status influence complement activation against SARS-CoV-2 mRNA vaccine Spike protein
papers.translated_title: 性别、年龄和HIV-1状态影响针对SARS-CoV-2 mRNA疫苗Spike蛋白的补体激活
papers.author: Tuttle, D. J.
papers.summary: Regulation of complement activity influences immunity and clinical outcomes of SARS-2 CoV-2 infections. Here we investigated antibody responses to SARS-CoV-2 vaccination and complement activity in men (age 36 to 86) and women (age 39 to 83) with (MWH, WWH) and without (MWOH, WWOH) HIV-1. Antibody responses in WWH were lower than in MWH. WWH also had negligible change in blood C3a post-immunization, whereas MWH had greater C3a levels. We investigated the levels of C5, C5a, C1-INH, factor H, and circulating immune complex-C1q (CIC-C1q) binding to understand the regulation of complement activity. We found that C1-INH and anti-S antibody levels were driving the differences in C3 convertase activity in MWH. No significant differences were found between C5 and C5a in both cohorts, suggesting that C5 convertase is not being activated. These results show that biological sex may impact SARS-CoV-2 immune responses and highlights the need for further investigation.
papers.translated_summary: 补体活性的调控影响SARS-2 CoV-2感染的免疫和临床结局。本研究调查了伴（MWH、WWH）与不伴（MWOH、WWOH）HIV-1感染的男性（年龄36至86岁）和女性（年龄39至83岁）对SARS-CoV-2疫苗接种的抗体反应及补体活性。WWH的抗体反应低于MWH。WWH免疫后血液C3a变化可忽略不计，而MWH的C3a水平较高。我们检测了C5、C5a、C1-INH、因子H以及循环免疫复合物-C1q（CIC-C1q）结合水平，以了解补体活性的调控。我们发现C1-INH和抗S抗体水平驱动了MWH中C3转化酶活性的差异。两个队列中C5与C5a之间均未发现显著差异，提示C5转化酶未被激活。这些结果表明生物学性别可能影响SARS-CoV-2免疫反应，并凸显了进一步研究的必要性。

papers.title: Genotypic infection endpoint analysis to understand efficacy and escape potential of the malaria monoclonal antibody CIS43LS
papers.translated_title: 基因型感染终点分析以理解疟疾单克隆抗体CIS43LS的效力和逃逸潜力
papers.author: Schwabl, P.
papers.summary: Early-phase trials of candidate malaria interventions in endemic areas often use "time-to-first" infection as a primary efficacy endpoint. This approach does not assess infection risk after the initial infection, and its censoring of trial participants after their first infection can introduce bias by removing more high-risk participants from control than treatment arms over time. Efficacy estimate precision may also decline as risk set size decreases. Here we assessed the utility of genotyping all infections in an intervention trial to determine the total infection incidence in each participant for the full follow-up period. Specifically, we genotyped all Plasmodium falciparum infections detected in a previously-reported phase 2 trial of the antimalarial monoclonal antibody CIS43LS in 330 Malian adults. We determined the molecular force of infection (molFOI; rate of new P. falciparum strains) for each participant, expressing efficacy as the percent molFOI reduction in CIS43LS versus placebo arms (EffmolFOI). Six-month EffmolFOI was 86.5% (95% CI: 80.1-90.8) and 70.7% (61.0-78.0) for the 40 mg/kg and 10 mg/kg doses, respectively. These estimates are similar to those from time-to-first infection analysis, but more precise when analyzing efficacy by trial-month and when stratifying by P. falciparum infection-status at enrollment. Participants infected at enrollment had lower EffmolFOI and acquired infections earlier in the trial, creating systematic differences in risk composition between arms over time. Genotyping showed no evidence for escape-polymorphisms in the CIS43LS epitope. These results demonstrate how genotypic endpoints can provide a more comprehensive understanding of candidate malaria interventions.
papers.translated_summary: 在疟疾流行区开展的候选疟疾干预措施早期试验，常以“首次感染时间”作为主要疗效终点。该方法不评估初次感染后的感染风险，且在受试者首次感染后对其进行删失，会随着时间推移使对照组中高风险受试者被剔除的比例高于治疗组，从而引入偏倚。随着风险集规模缩小，疗效估计的精确度也可能下降。在此，我们评估了一项干预试验中对所有感染进行基因分型的效用，以确定每位受试者在整个随访期内的总感染发生率。具体而言，我们对一项先前报道的、在330名马里成年人中开展的抗疟单克隆抗体CIS43LS 2期试验中检测到的所有恶性疟原虫感染进行了基因分型。我们确定了每位受试者的分子感染力（molFOI；新恶性疟原虫株的出现率），并将疗效表示为CIS43LS组相对于安慰剂组的molFOI降低百分比（EffmolFOI）。40 mg/kg和10 mg/kg剂量组的六个月EffmolFOI分别为86.5%（95% CI：80.1-90.8）和70.7%（61.0-78.0）。这些估计值与首次感染时间分析的结果相似，但在按试验月份分析疗效以及按入组时恶性疟原虫感染状态分层时更为精确。入组时已感染的受试者EffmolFOI较低，且在试验中更早获得感染，导致各组间随时间推移的风险构成出现系统性差异。基因分型未显示CIS43LS表位存在逃逸多态性的证据。这些结果表明，基因型终点如何能够更全面地理解候选疟疾干预措施。
